document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

text: A growing number of employers, from software firms to local councils, are experimenting with a four-day week without reducing salaries. In my opinion, the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages, at least in jobs where productivity depends on concentration rather than on being physically present.

The most significant benefit is for employees' health and motivation. A three-day weekend gives people time to rest, exercise and spend time with their families, and many companies that have tried the system report lower levels of stress and fewer sick days. Surprisingly, productivity often stays the same or even rises, because staff are more focused and waste less time in unnecessary meetings. In addition, a shorter week can help employers attract and keep talented workers, who increasingly value flexibility as much as pay.

Nevertheless, the model has clear limitations. In sectors such as healthcare, retail and transport, services must be available every day, so a four-day week would require hiring more staff, which small businesses in particular may not be able to afford. There is also a risk that employees try to fit five days of work into four, leading to longer, more exhausting working days rather than genuine rest.

On balance, I believe these problems can be managed rather than seen as reasons to reject the idea. Businesses could introduce the change gradually, keep it optional in sectors that need constant cover, and measure results instead of hours worked.

In conclusion, although a four-day week is not suitable for every industry and must be carefully planned, its benefits for wellbeing, productivity and recruitment make it a development that outweighs its drawbacks.

document.title: A four-day working week
document.question:
More and more companies are introducing a four-day working week. Some people see this as the future of work, while others worry about its effect on businesses and the economy.

Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
